name: Tamam
description: Family-style Greek cooking with Ottoman and wider Eastern Mediterranean influences, served in a former bathhouse near the old harbour.

name: Gramboussa Restaurant
description: A village restaurant known for generous Cretan dishes, home-grown ingredients and a leafy courtyard near the Balos route. The venue does not take reservations.

name: Pallas
description: An all-day waterfront address for breakfast through dinner, with a broad drinks list and views across Chania’s Venetian harbour.

name: Dounias
description: A destination taverna where seasonal produce and meat are cooked over wood fires in a mountain village setting.

name: Kross Coffee Roasters
description: Chania-based roasters serving carefully sourced coffees across several city shops, with pastries and an easy neighbourhood feel.

name: Salis
description: A seasonal kitchen on the harbour working closely with Cretan growers, backed by a notably deep Greek and international wine list.

name: EnLefko
description: A small south-coast dining room focused on fresh fish, seafood and Greek wines. Ask what landed that day and reserve in high season.

name: Avli
description: Refined Cretan cooking in the courtyard of a restored Venetian-era residence, supported by an extensive cellar and local pantry.

name: Ali Vafi’s Garden
description: Coffee, food and cocktails unfold through the day in a green courtyard set within a historic old-town building.

name: Bricks Beers & Tales
description: A relaxed seafront beer house pouring independent Cretan and Greek brews alongside international taps and cocktails.

name: Kastro Cretan Cuisine
description: Traditional island flavours presented with a modern hand in Panormos, with a full drinks and cocktail menu.

name: Alpha Omega
description: A family-run Plakias restaurant combining Cretan recipes and local ingredients with a contemporary seaside approach.

name: Peskesi
description: A polished exploration of Cretan food using produce from the restaurant’s own organic farm and recipes rooted in island tradition.

name: Jasmine
description: A city-centre all-day venue pairing modern Mediterranean plates and breakfast with a dedicated handcrafted cocktail programme.

name: Ferryman
description: A long-running waterfront restaurant in Elounda serving Cretan and Mediterranean dishes with direct views across Mirabello Bay.

name: Piato
description: A family restaurant operating since 1980, evolving Cretan and Greek flavours through seasonal ingredients and a substantial wine cellar.

name: Pelagos Sea Side Restaurant
description: A seaside dining room centred on fish, seafood and Mediterranean dishes, suited to a leisurely meal near Agios Nikolaos.

name: Cavo
description: A seafront restaurant and bar with a substantial signature-cocktail list, best suited to sunset drinks that can stretch into dinner.
